name: FaceAID
tagline: Lets first responders scan a patient's face or ID to see allergies, medications and emergency contacts.

awards: VTHacks - Best Hack Supporting Diversity & Inclusion

problem: Responders often treat unconscious patients with no medical information.
solution: A mobile app authenticates a patient by face or ID scan and shows a prioritised summary of registered health data.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a face and see the allergy list.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VTHacks - Best Hack Supporting Diversity & Inclusion” among 112 submissions.
Puts critical data in front of responders within seconds.

lessons: Show the one fact that changes treatment.
